name: MESH-API
description: Off-Grid AI + Mesh Router for Meshtastic - Seamlessly connect LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, 3rd-party APIs, and Home Assistant to your LoRa mesh. Supports custom commands, Twilio SMS (inbound/outbound), Discord channel routing, and GPS emergency alerts via SMS, email, or Discord.
requires:
Requires multiple files to exist prior to starting the container. Run `touch FILE_NAME` for all files listed here: See configuration details: https://github.com/mr-tbot/mesh-api/blob/main/docker-compose.yml 
        [br]
        Expects a `config.json` file to be mounted at `/app/config.json` before starting the container. See configuration details: https://github.com/mr-tbot/mesh-api#configuration
